movelist.name: Captivate
movelist.effect: Captivate lowers the target’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages. Captivate may not affect something that is the same gender as the user or something that is genderless.

movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Rage Powder
movelist.effect: All targets hit by Rage Powder are Enraged. While enraged, they must shift to target the user when using a Move or Attack if the user is within reach.  If the user is Fainted or Switched out, all targets hit by Rage Powder are cured of rage.

movelist.name: Tailwind
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the encounter, all allied trainers and Pokémon gain +5 to their Initiative. Multiple instances of Tailwind cannot stack.

movelist.name: Silver Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.effect: The user gains a +3 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls.

abilities.name: Flutter
abilities.effect: The user gains +3 Evasion until the end of their next turn, and cannot be Flanked.

abilities.name: Blow Away
abilities.effect: Connection - Whirlwind. When the user uses Whirlwind, all targets hit are pushed an additional 2 meters and lose a Tick of Hit Points.
